headline: SeedBank Launches, Bringing Professional Lawn Care to the Local Community
author: Jordan McAllister
body: CLARKSVILLE, TN — A new lawn care and landscaping company, SeedBank, officially opened for business this week, offering mowing, trimming, edging, cleanup, and general yard care to residential and commercial customers across the area.

The company is led by General Manager Cesar, who oversees daily operations, coordinates the team, and schedules jobs to keep customers happy. He's joined by Weston, who manages the books and helps set pricing as Finance & Accounting Manager; Tshawn, who runs marketing and outreach as Marketing & Sales Coordinator; and Colton, who keeps equipment and field crews running smoothly as Operations Manager.
"Our goal is simple — reliable, quality lawn care delivered with a smile," the founding team said in a statement announcing the launch. SeedBank is now hiring Field Agents to help meet early demand.
Shares of SeedBank (SEED) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Bleu Room Opens Its Doors, Serving Up Multi-Cuisine Favorites in a Stylish New Space
author: Priya Chandrasekar
body: "Our goal is fast, smooth service without losing the personal touch," says General Manager Marcus Spinks, describing the vision behind Bleu Room, the new restaurant that opened this week blending comforting classics with bold international flavors in a stylish, welcoming space.

Spinks oversees both the front-of-house and kitchen at the new Clarksville spot. He's supported by Marketing Coordinator Yucheng Weng, who handles digital and print campaigns; Financial Manager Jack Hicks, who keeps the books balanced and pricing sharp; and Floor Manager Ace Doane, who keeps the dining room running and guests smiling.
The restaurant is now hiring for its kitchen, with an open Cook/Dishwasher position for anyone passionate about food preparation.
Shares of Bleu Room (BLEU) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Bubbles & Barks Brings Mobile Dog Grooming Straight to Local Driveways
author: Sam O'Rourke
body: Local dog owners no longer have to make the trip to a grooming salon. A new mobile dog wash and grooming business, Bubbles & Barks, launched this week with a fleet of equipped grooming vans ready to bring baths, brushing, trims, and nail care right to customers' homes.

At the helm is Manager Kristen Abrams, who oversees daily operations, schedules appointments, and keeps quality high across the growing team. She's joined by Sales Manager Addy Hofmans, who books appointments and grows the customer base; Marketing Coordinator Riley Denote, who spreads the word through social media and local promotions; and IT Support lead Harmony James, who keeps the booking system and payment technology running smoothly.

The company says it's aiming to become a dependable local service that keeps dogs clean and comfortable while making life easier for their owners, and is now hiring its tenth groomer as it completes staffing for five mobile vans.
Shares of Bubbles & Barks (BARK) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Pease Beez Debuts All-Natural, Honey-Based Health and Beauty Line
author: Elena Vasquez
body: Natural, simple, humane, healthy — those four words guide everything at Pease Beez, a new health and beauty company built around hand-made honey-based products that launched this week with a mission to bring natural, whole-body wellness to customers looking for simpler, more humane alternatives to typical beauty products.

General Manager Emme Dressler leads the company as primary manager, overseeing daily operations and key business decisions. She's joined by Sales Manager Tori Ross, who manages customer relationships and sales channels; Marketing Coordinator Ameila Pease, who builds brand awareness through advertising and social media; and Product Manager Major Peevyhouse, who oversees the quality and development of the company's honey-based goods.

"We're a new business with big hopes of becoming one of the world's largest health and beauty companies," the team said. Pease Beez is now hiring an IT Support specialist to help build out its online presence.
Shares of Pease Beez (BEEZ) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Stone Age Climbing & Fitness Opens Doors to Clarksville's Newest Rock Climbing Gym
author: Marcus Whitfield
body: Shares of Stone Age Climbing & Fitness (CRAG) opened trading at $15.00 today as the company celebrated the launch of one of the area's only dedicated rock climbing gyms, paired with a full strength-training and fitness facility for members of all skill levels.

General Manager Robert Simons oversees the gym as primary manager, ensuring operations run smoothly, safely, and effectively. He's joined by Marketing Manager Bailey Battles, who works to attract and retain members; Storekeeper Kale Patterson, who runs the retail side and equipment sales; and Financial Advisor Traden Lundrigan, who manages the company's budget and funding.

"We want to build a community that cares for and challenges each other — and become Stronger by Nature," the team said. The gym is now hiring a Trainer to help lead group sessions for beginners through advanced climbers.

headline: My Pick for Clarksville's Best New Business Concept of 2026: Stone Age Climbing & Fitness
author: Jordyn Everhart, Local Fitness Influencer
body: I try a lot of new fitness spots around Clarksville for my page, and it's rare that one earns a spontaneous shoutout instead of a scheduled review. Stone Age Climbing & Fitness just earned my vote for 2026's Best New Business Concept in town — and I don't hand that out lightly.

Here's the pitch, in case you haven't heard: it's one of the only dedicated rock climbing gyms in the area, paired with a full strength-training and fitness facility, so you're not choosing between a climbing session and a regular gym day. It's all under one roof.

As a creator, what stood out to me is how much this place gives me to work with. The gym's new Trainer role is built around changing the climbing routes every single month, which means there's always something new on the wall to film, attempt, and occasionally fail at on camera. And because the space is set up for total beginners and serious climbers alike, a first-timer post and an advanced-technique post can both live on the same feed without feeling out of place — that's harder to pull off than it sounds.

General Manager Robert Simons and the team have been clear that the goal isn't just memberships — it's building "a community that cares for and challenges each other," and you can feel that intention in how the gym is staffing up. They're currently hiring a Trainer who has to be belay and climbing rescue certified, which tells me safety isn't an afterthought here — it's part of the culture from day one, and that's exactly what I want to be able to tell my followers before I send them somewhere new.

Add in a dedicated retail and equipment setup run by Storekeeper Kale Patterson and the financial groundwork Financial Advisor Traden Lundrigan and Marketing Manager Bailey Battles are laying to grow the brand, and it's easy to see why this is my pick for the year. The market seems to agree: shares of Stone Age Climbing & Fitness (CRAG) climbed $2.00 today, closing at $17.00, on the news.

headline: Crosshairs & Scriptures Launches Faith-Inspired Outdoor Apparel Line
author: Nadia Okafor
body: Graphic t-shirts, hats, and accessories designed for customers who want to show their faith alongside their love of hunting and the outdoors hit the market this week as Crosshairs & Scriptures, a new Christian outdoor-inspired apparel brand, officially launched.

General Manager Joel Gish leads the business as primary manager, overseeing final decisions and keeping the team organized around its product roadmap. He's joined by Marketing Manager Richard, who runs the brand's social media presence; Sales Manager Kingston, who manages customer orders and looks for ways to grow sales; and Product Manager Brennon, who develops new designs and oversees inventory.
The company sells its apparel through an online store and social media, with a mission to create products that let customers represent both their faith and their outdoor lifestyle.
Shares of Crosshairs & Scriptures (AMEN) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Coffee Trip Rolls Out a Moving Cafe, Bringing Coffee and Baked Goods Anywhere
author: Derek Lindqvist
body: Rent the cafe. Get the coffee. That's the pitch behind Coffee Trip, a new mobile cafe business that launched this week promising a fresh cup of coffee and baked goods served with a smile, anywhere, at any time.

General Manager Annika Sosa leads the company as primary manager, planning and organizing operations to keep things running smoothly. She's joined by Financial Manager Timmy, who advises on the company's financial health and strategy, and Marketing Coordinator Kamiyah Hollins, who makes sure campaigns reach the right audience.
The small team says it's focused on doing a few things well: friendly service, quality coffee, and flexibility to show up wherever customers need them.
Shares of Coffee Trip (JAVA) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Frontier Kitchen Opens for Business, Serving Up a New Dining Experience
author: Callie Ashworth
body: Frontier Kitchen opened its doors this week, bringing a new restaurant to the local hospitality scene with a focus on strong daily operations and a memorable menu and brand experience for guests.

General Manager Maddy Kosturko leads the restaurant as primary manager, assigning tasks, coordinating staff schedules, and keeping the team aligned with customer service standards. She's joined by Sales Manager Freddy Monroe, who trains staff on menu recommendations and works to boost repeat visits; Marketing Manager Truman Gill, who runs social media and promotes special events; and Finance Manager Troy Campbell, who tracks the budget and keeps the business on solid financial footing.
Founded in 2024 according to its branding, Frontier Kitchen is now staffing up its front-of-house and kitchen teams as it settles into the local dining scene.
Shares of Frontier Kitchen (GRUB) opened trading at $15.00 today.

headline: Natura Energy Launches All-Natural Energy Drink Line
author: Theo Bramwell
body: The energy drink aisle has a new all-natural contender. Natura Energy launched this week with a lineup of energy drinks aimed at giving customers a healthier alternative to typical options on the market.

The company is led by Aniyah, who serves as Overseer and primary manager, keeping operations running smoothly and the team aligned with company goals. She's joined by Jodi Miller, who leads marketing and brand awareness; Natalie, who handles HR and customer service; and Mia, who manages sales strategy and the company's finances.
Natura Energy says its mission is simple: supply healthier, all-natural energy drinks to the public. The company is now hiring an IT Specialist Manager to help support its growing technology needs.
Shares of Natura Energy (VOLT) opened trading at $15.00 today.
